The first release of VLC 4 with Juxtopposed's redesign. It is built on VLC 4.0.0-dev, which VideoLAN has not released yet, so treat it like a development build.

## ✨ Added

- A redesigned library: home, videos, music, network and playlists, in grid or list view, with sorting and search.
- A redesigned player. Its controls and the window frame stay hidden until the pointer is over the window.
- A side panel in the player for playback, video, audio and subtitle settings.
- Customize Player, with separate control bars for video and audio.
- Global Settings on 13 pages. VLC's full preferences stay reachable under Advanced Options.
- A first-run setup for theme, layout and accent colour.
- Dark, light and system themes, nine accent colours and a picker for any other one, in Global Settings > General > Appearance.
- Volume in accent color, in the same place, fills the volume slider with the accent colour.

## ⚡ Improved

- On Windows, VLC closes in about half a second, and a file opened by double-click while VLC is still closing is played instead of lost.
- On Windows 11 the window has no coloured border.

## 📦 Downloads

- `vlc-redesign-windows-amd64.zip` and `vlc-redesign-windows-arm64.zip`: unpack anywhere and start `vlc.exe`. Settings go to `%APPDATA%\vlc`, which an installed VLC uses too. An empty folder named `portable` next to `vlc.exe` keeps them in there instead.
- `vlc-redesign-linux-amd64.AppImage` and `vlc-redesign-linux-arm64.AppImage`: `chmod +x` it and run it. It needs glibc 2.35 or later, so Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 or anything newer.

The builds are not signed, and they do not check for updates, so VLC never offers to replace them with VideoLAN's own version. There is no macOS build, since VLC uses its native interface there.
